key_idea: Walk the road like Eva and turn with her. Only read a letter when it is on her right.
steps: From point 1 she walks to the right. Below the road are K and then A. They are on her right. The M above is on her left.
She turns and walks down. The A is still on her right. B and P are on her left.
She walks to the right again. Below the road are T and O, on her right.
She walks down to point 2. The O is still on her right, and R is on her left.
She reads each letter once: K, A, T, O. That spells KATO.

choice_feedback.A: The M is above the first part of the road, on her left.
choice_feedback.C: B and R are on her left side, not her right.
choice_feedback.D: M, B, P and R are all on her left side.
choice_feedback.E: Do not forget the O at the end. It is on her right too.
